slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Definition: two figures are congruent if there is a sequence of rigid motions that maps one onto the other.

Because rigid motions preserve distance and angle, congruent figures have all corresponding lengths and angles equal. A mirror image is congruent: a reflection is a rigid motion. This replaces our working definition from Unit 2: congruent segments have equal lengths, and congruent angles have equal measures, because those are exactly the ones a rigid motion can match up.
